hbw_pass_scout: Scout Aelin Frost. You have come down the pass out of Silverpine, and this is the north-west corner of Hillsbrad. Take a breath. The air here does not have the blight in it. Southpoint Tower is just south of us - report there before the valley notices you.
hbw_southpoint_deathguard: Deathguard Orlin, Southpoint Tower. The militia come up the road from the Fields twice a week to look at us. We look back. Nobody has swung yet, and I have a wager with the Commander about who does first.
hbw_southpoint_commander: Commander Hale Rethven. Southpoint is one tower in the north-west of the valley, with every farm in Hillsbrad watching it. We hold what we can see from the top. The Fields are south-east of here and Southshore beyond them, and both would like us gone.
hbw_southpoint_apothecary: Jessel Vane, apothecary to Southpoint. Green country. Do you know how long it has been since I had anything LIVING to work with? Silverpine sent me ashes for four years. Here even the weeds have sap in them.
hbw_pasture_herder: Maud Kellen. These are the Foothill Pastures, the north of the valley under the snowline, and the rams are mine. Yetis come down when it turns cold. The rams know it before I do. I do not care whose flag is on that tower so long as somebody deals with the yetis.
hbw_mine_overseer: Overseer Grint Halloway. That hole is Azurelode Mine, on the west side of the valley. It was the richest silver seam in Hillsbrad. Now it is the wettest, and what has moved into the water does not mine.
hbw_fields_scout: Scout Bren Ashby. I watch the Hillsbrad Fields from their north edge. Count the militia, count the marines, report, repeat. Riveting work. The fields are in front of you and Southshore is south, behind them.
hbw_mine_surveyor: Pell Iversen, surveyor. I mapped Azurelode before it flooded - the mouth is just north-west of where we are standing. The map is worth more than the mine now, and I am the only one who can read it.
hbw_fields_agent: Agent Sarra Dunwick. You are in the middle of the Hillsbrad Fields, so keep your voice down. The farmhands out here still think this is their valley. I am not in a hurry to correct them. I am in a hurry to know who is drilling them.
hbw_road_outrider: Outrider Kess. This is the east end of the valley road. Keep on it and you come out in Eastern Hillsbrad, with Tarren Mill to the north-east. Stay on the road. What is off it is not friendly and not slow.
hbw_fields_poacher: Tam Hollis. Poacher, if you ask the Marshal. I keep to the south edge of the Fields. I take a ram now and then. He calls it theft. The rams have no opinion, and the dead in the tower pay better than he does.
hbw_strand_tidewatcher: Tidewatcher Nols. This is the Western Strand, the valley's west coast. Murlocs on the sand, and something further out that the murlocs are frightened of. I watch the tide so that somebody knows when it changes its mind.
hbw_southshore_spy: Lia Marrow. Do not use my name down here. Southshore is south-east of this hedge - awake, armed, and a great deal stronger than Southpoint. Walk in the front and you will not walk out. I go in the other way.
hbw_orchard_forager: Ned Quill. I forage the Hillsbrad Orchard, east of Southshore. Apples the size of your fist, and wasps the size of your hand guarding every one of them. The town used to send pickers. Now it sends nobody, so they are mine.
hbw_southshore_saboteur: Henk. I be workin' de north side of Southshore, close as I can get. Dey build a dock, I burn a dock. Simple arrangement. Works fine. Lately dey be buildin' faster.
hbw_purgation_castaway: Ilsa Roane. This is Purgation Shore, the south-west corner of the valley, and I have not found a way off it that does not go past them. My ship went down off this beach. Everyone else who came up out of the water came up wrong.
